# AMBOSS


> Digital medical knowledge platform providing an evidence-based library, exam preparation, and clinical decision support for students, physicians, nurses, and institutions across US, international, and German markets.


## US Website (amboss.com/us)


### Overview & Getting Started
- [Explore AMBOSS (US)](https://www.amboss.com/us): Product overview and tour for US users
- [Login](https://www.amboss.com/us/account/login): Access your AMBOSS account
- [Sign Up – 5-Day Free Trial](https://next.amboss.com/us/registration): Start a free trial with full access
- [Pricing](https://www.amboss.com/us/pricing): Subscription plans for US learners and clinicians
- [Group Discounts](https://www.amboss.com/us/group-discounts): Discounted access for study groups and cohorts


### For Medical Students (US)
- [Students Overview](https://www.amboss.com/us/students): Central hub for US medical students
- [Pre‑Clerkship Resources](https://www.amboss.com/us/students/study): Study tools for pre‑clinical years
- [Clerkships](https://www.amboss.com/us/students/clerkships): Rotation guides, clinical skills, and survival tips
- [Exam Preparation](https://www.amboss.com/us/students/exams): Unified view of exam prep options
- [USMLE® Hub](https://www.amboss.com/us/usmle): High‑yield prep for USMLE Steps 1, 2 CK, and 3
- [Shelf Exams](https://www.amboss.com/us/shelf): NBME Shelf exam preparation across core rotations
- [USMLE® Self‑Assessment](https://www.amboss.com/us/usmle/self-assessment): Full‑length self‑assessments for Step prep
- [Score Predictor](https://www.amboss.com/us/score-predictor): Predictive model for USMLE exam performance


### For Physician Assistants (US)
- [PA‑S Hub](https://www.amboss.com/us/pa/pance): All‑in‑one resource for PA students and PANCE prep
- [EOR™ Exams](https://www.amboss.com/us/pa/eor): End‑of‑Rotation exam question banks
- [PA Programs](https://www.amboss.com/us/pa/programs): Institutional tools and analytics for PA programs


### For Clinicians (US)
- [AMBOSS for Clinicians](https://www.amboss.com/us/clinicians): Clinical decision support overview
- [Differential Diagnosis](https://www.amboss.com/us/clinicians/differential-diagnosis): Interactive DDx builder
- [Management Checklists](https://www.amboss.com/us/clinicians/acute-management-checklists): Step‑by‑step acute management protocols
- [Clinical Calculators](https://www.amboss.com/us/clinicians/clinical-calculators): Point‑of‑care calculator suite
- [Drug Database](https://www.amboss.com/us/clinicians/drug-database): Medication monographs and dosing guidance
- [One Minute Telegram](https://www.amboss.com/us/clinicians/one-minute-telegram): Concise clinical update format
- [Take the Tour](https://www.amboss.com/us#medical-excellence): Guided walkthrough of clinical features


### Board Review & CME (US)
- [CME Courses](https://www.amboss.com/us/courses): ACCME‑accredited CME and masterclasses
- [USMLE® Step 3](https://www.amboss.com/us/clinicians/step3): Step 3 resources for residents and clinicians
- [Internal Medicine (ABIM®)](https://www.amboss.com/us/board-review/internal-medicine): IM board exam preparation
- [Family Medicine (ABFM®)](https://www.amboss.com/us/board-review/family-medicine): FM board exam preparation
- [Pediatrics (ABP)](https://www.amboss.com/us/board-review/pediatrics): Pediatrics board review
- [NEJM Knowledge+](https://www.amboss.com/us/clinicians/nejm-knowledge-plus): Integrated NEJM Knowledge+ board prep


### Core Features (US)
- [Knowledge Library](https://www.amboss.com/us/knowledge/index): Evidence‑based library of pre‑clinical and clinical topics
- [Popular Features – Learn](https://www.amboss.com/us/features?tab=learn): Key features for studying and learning
- [Popular Features – Practice](https://www.amboss.com/us/features?tab=practice): Question bank and practice tools
- [Mobile Apps](https://www.amboss.com/us/mobile-app): iOS and Android apps with offline usage
- [Anki Add‑on](https://www.amboss.com/us/anki): Integration between AMBOSS and Anki
- [Chrome Extension](https://www.amboss.com/us/chrome): Browser add‑on for instant definitions
- [Free Chrome Extension (Store)](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/amboss-medical-knowledge/hnlpidgbnmikgkmccephgaljihheckii?hl=en&pli=1): Direct Chrome Web Store listing
- [AMBOSS GPT](https://www.amboss.com/us/gpt): AI‑powered assistant based on AMBOSS content
- [AI Features](https://www.amboss.com/us/ai-innovation): Overview of AI‑driven tools


### Institutions & Programs (US)
- [Residency Programs](https://www.amboss.com/us/residency-programs): Program‑wide access, analytics, and support
- [Study & Exam Preparation (Residents)](https://www.amboss.com/us/residency-programs/exam-prep): Exam prep tools for residents
- [Clinical Decision Support (Residents)](https://www.amboss.com/us/residency-programs/clinical-support): AMBOSS in daily resident workflow
- [Educators](https://www.amboss.com/us/residency-programs/educators): Tools for program directors and faculty
- [Educator Tools](https://www.amboss.com/us/features?tab=teach): Assignments, tracking, and curriculum mapping
- [Residents Survey](https://www.amboss.com/us/residency-programs/residents-survey): Insights into resident usage and impact
- [Medical Schools](https://www.amboss.com/us/medical-schools): Campus licenses and curriculum alignment
- [PA Programs](https://www.amboss.com/us/pa/programs): Institutional PA program partnerships


### Company, Help & Legal (US)
- [Explore the Difference](https://www.amboss.com/us#medical-excellence): Why clinicians and students choose AMBOSS
- [Visit our Newsroom](https://www.amboss.com/us/newsroom): Product and company announcements
- [Love Notes (Reviews)](https://www.amboss.com/us/reviews): User testimonials
- [About Us](https://www.amboss.com/us/about): Mission, history, and team
- [Advisory Board](https://www.amboss.com/us/advisory-board): Medical and academic advisors
- [Careers](https://careers.amboss.com/): Open roles and hiring information
- [Blog](https://blog.amboss.com/us): Educational content and product updates
- [AI Principles](https://www.amboss.com/us/ai-principles): Responsible AI guidelines
- [Help Center](https://support.amboss.com/hc/en-us): Support articles and contact options
- [Terms of Use](https://www.amboss.com/us/legal/terms): Legal terms for US users
- [Terms and Conditions for Clinics](https://www.amboss.com/us/legal/terms-clinics): Institutional terms
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.amboss.com/us/legal/privacy-policy-overview): Data and privacy practices
- [Legal Notice](https://www.amboss.com/us/legal/legal-notice): Legal entity and contact
- [Report illegal content](https://forms.gle/VrAvSaCbx1sDXo7c6): Content reporting form
- [Accessibility Information](https://www.amboss.com/us/legal/accessibility): Accessibility statement
- [Language Switcher – DE](https://www.amboss.com/de): German site entry point
- [Language Switcher – INT](https://www.amboss.com/int): International English entry point




## International Website (amboss.com/int)


### Overview & Getting Started (INT)
- [AMBOSS – INT Overview](https://www.amboss.com/int): Landing page for international English users
- [Login](https://next.amboss.com/us/login): Shared login endpoint
- [5‑Day Free Trial](https://next.amboss.com/us/registration): Trial signup for international users

- [Clerkships](https://www.amboss.com/int/students/clerkship): International clerkship resources
- [Group Discounts](https://www.amboss.com/int/group-discounts): Discounts for non‑US study groups


### International & US Exams (INT)

- [Step 1](https://www.amboss.com/int/usmle/step1): Step 1 resources and Qbank
- [Step 2 CK](https://www.amboss.com/int/usmle/step2): Step 2 CK resources and Qbank
- [Step 3](https://www.amboss.com/int/clinicians/step3): Step 3 for international clinicians
- [USMLE® Score Predictor](https://www.amboss.com/int/usmle/score-predictor): Readiness estimation
- [USMLE® Self‑Assessment](https://www.amboss.com/int/usmle/self-assessment): Practice exams
- [IFOM (Español)](https://www.amboss.com/int/ifom-cse-qbank/es): IFOM exam prep in Spanish
- [MCCQE Part I](https://www.amboss.com/int/ca/mccqe-qbank): Canadian licensing exam prep
- [SMLE](https://www.amboss.com/int/sa/smle): Saudi Medical Licensing Exam prep
- [PNA](https://www.amboss.com/int/pt/pna): Portuguese national exam prep


### Clinicians & Board Review (INT)
- [AMBOSS for Clinicians (INT)](https://www.amboss.com/int/clinicians): International clinician overview
- [CME Courses](https://www.amboss.com/int/courses): Continuing education for international users
- [Internal Medicine (ABIM®)](https://www.amboss.com/int/board-review/internal-medicine): IM board review (INT)
- [Family Medicine (ABFM®)](https://www.amboss.com/int/board-review/family-medicine): FM board review (INT)
- [Pediatrics (ABP)](https://www.amboss.com/int/board-review/pediatrics): Pediatrics board review (INT)
- [Differential Diagnosis](https://www.amboss.com/int/clinicians/differential-diagnosis): DDx builder (INT)
- [Management Checklist](https://www.amboss.com/int/clinicians/acute-management-checklist): Acute management checklists
- [Clinical Calculators](https://www.amboss.com/int/clinicians/clinical-calculators): Calculator tools (INT)
- [Drug Database](https://www.amboss.com/int/clinicians/drug-database): Medication references (INT)
- [One Minute Telegram](https://www.amboss.com/int/clinicians/one-minute-telegram): Brief clinical updates
- [NEJM Knowledge+](https://www.amboss.com/int/clinicians/nejm-knowledge-plus): Integrated NEJM board review


### Core Features & Integrations (INT)
- [Popular Features / Tour](https://www.amboss.com/int/tour): Feature overview for INT users
- [Knowledge Library](https://www.amboss.com/us/knowledge): Shared evidence‑based library
- [Mobile Apps](https://www.amboss.com/int/mobile-app): Mobile access for INT users
- [Anki Add‑on](https://www.amboss.com/int/anki): International Anki integration page
- [Chrome Extension](https://www.amboss.com/int/chrome): Chrome extension (INT)
- [AMBOSS GPT](https://www.amboss.com/int/gpt): AI study assistant (INT)


### Institutions & Initiatives (INT)
- [Medical Schools](https://www.amboss.com/int/institutions): Institutional solutions for universities
- [Residency Programs](https://www.amboss.com/int/residency-programs): International residency support
- [Study & Exam Preparation](https://www.amboss.com/int/residency-programs/study-exam-prep): Exam prep for residents
- [Clinical Decision Support](https://www.amboss.com/int/residency-programs/clinical-support): CDS for residency programs
- [Educators](https://www.amboss.com/int/residency-programs/educators): Faculty tools and analytics
- [Residents Survey](https://www.amboss.com/int/residency-programs/residents-survey): International resident feedback
- [Humanitarian Initiative](https://www.amboss.com/int/humanitarian/initiative): Access for humanitarian projects
- [Global Health Initiative](https://www.amboss.com/int/global-health-initiative): Global health collaborations


### Company, Help & Legal (INT)
- [Pricing](https://www.amboss.com/int): Pricing overview entry point
- [Pricing – Detail](https://www.amboss.com/int/pricing): Detailed pricing page
- [About Us](https://www.amboss.com/int/about): International company overview
- [Advisory Board](https://www.amboss.com/int/advisory-board): Advisory board (INT)
- [Careers](https://careers.amboss.com/): Global careers

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.amboss.com/int/int-legal/privacy-policy-overview): Data and privacy information
